statement: The client presents a dynamic risk profile with a risk class of 4, a 15-year investment horizon, a growth objective, and a high capacity to bear losses. The proposed portfolio consists of the iShares Core MSCI World UCITS ETF (SRI 4) weighted at 60% and the Carmignac Patrimoine A EUR Acc (SRI 3) weighted at 40%. This portfolio is suitable because its weighted SRI of 3.6 and individual fund SRIs align with the client's risk class 4 profile. Furthermore, the client does not require liquidity within the next two years, matching the long-term nature of the proposed holdings. Draft for advisor review and signature.
